entries.look: Career → the travel map: point at (or tap) any track dot, including the European ones, which have no model yet. Then More from the archive → open Before the record, the explorer, Restarts, Qualifying to the flag, Biggest climbs and Rain, and point at any race. Also the GB3 and Euroformula season pictures, and the race strip at the top of About. On the phone the first tap reads, the second (or Open the race →) opens.
